title: Page 5
content_zh:
“这里比起京都感觉怎么样？”她倒退着走，穿着吊带裤，内搭白色薄长T，束个马尾在后头，说话的时候总是笑着，目光闪闪地望着他。

“更暖和些。”

“哇，好避重就轻的回答喔。”不是回答哪里比较美，而是笑谈气温，有没有这么狡猾的啊。

齐藤浅羽一笑。“京都的十月、十一月，该是红枫点缀着绿色山头的美丽景色，那红会一直四处延烧，每天都在变化着不同的色彩。”

舞冬末点点头。“听起来好美喔。比起这里只有绿绿的树和山……啊，看见花了。”

不远处，花丝如粉扑状散开，夹杂着粉和白和红，一球一球毛茸茸的，如烟花般的美在一片荒寂中显得十分的娇艳。

她兴奋地奔了过去，拿起手机便把它们拍了下来。

“这是什么花？”人已走近，就在她身后。

“它有一个很美的名字，叫香水合欢——”舞冬末边说边转过身，却未料他靠得这么近，一下便撞进他怀里，脚一个不稳差点就要跌倒——

他很快地扶住她。“怎么老是莽莽撞撞的？撞到哪里没有？”

她揉揉鼻子，摇头。

见状，他伸出手抓住她的手。“这样揉，鼻子会越来越扁，应该这样温柔地对待它。”说着，他把温热的掌心轻罩住她小巧的鼻尖。

他手大，这一罩，连她的唇一并给捂住了。

她闻到他掌心中清香的皂味，也感受到那股从他掌心传到她脸颊上的温热，露出的一双眼睛眨呀眨地望住他，他也正睨着她，瞬也不瞬的，这让她觉得身子变热了，连呼吸都觉得困难。

“不痛了。”她连忙拨掉他的手，背过身去深呼吸了好几次，才又说道：“那个香水合欢啊，之前我以为是没名字的野花呢，没想到回去查才知道它有这么美的名字，是不是美呆了？”

他的靠近让她紧张，她又习惯性话多了。

齐藤浅羽提唇一笑，又朝她靠近些，近到连她没长眼睛的背都知道他靠她靠得有多近。

“是美，不过这名字——”

她往前跨了一步然后回过头来，拉开了两人太近的距离。“因为它昼开夜合，夜晚时，它的叶片会两两相对亲密地合抱在一起，就像夫妻一样……”

话说到一半，舞冬末突然顿住，整张脸烧到快要起火了。

天啊，她为什么要告诉他这个花的名字啊？

“像夫妻欢好时一样抱在一起，故名合欢？”他很好心又聪明地替她接下去，还一副很受教的样子。“原来是因为这样，所以你觉得这名字很美啊。”

“才不是！”她又羞又恼地瞪他。“你这人满脑子不纯正，思想邪恶，根本是来找碴的！”

她害羞得脸红红的模样，真是可爱。

齐藤浅羽笑看着她，没有辩驳，就只是温柔地盯着她瞧，一直瞧一直瞧，瞧到她鼓起腮帮子转身大步往前走，很直接地把他丢在原地。

他就慢慢地走，跟在她身后，不远不近地跟着。

舞冬末知道他一直在后头，她也知道这从头到尾都是她自己在发自己的脾气。他太从容，她太浮躁；他太聪明，而她太笨……明明是出来玩的，她却把场面搞得像是小女朋友在闹脾气……这真的很好笑。

想着，她深吸了一口气，转头往回走，一直走到他面前三步之遥才打住。“对不起，我不该骂你的。”

真的，勇于认错是她的良好美德，而他喜欢她这个美德，怎么看怎么可爱。

他温柔地笑道：“好，我接受。”

舞冬末觑着他，笑了笑，又不好意思了，瞧天瞧地就是不敢瞧他。“为了赔罪，等一下你多吃点我亲手做的寿司。”

“可以换个赔罪的方式吗？那寿司本来就是要给我吃的。”

“那……你想要我怎么赔罪？”

“这样。”他上前拉住她的手。

好看修长的大手，轻握住她白皙柔嫩的小手。

心，像是被世上最轻柔的羽毛给拂过，痒痒的很舒服，却一点都不真实。

“学长……这是什么意思？”舞冬末脸红红地看着两人交握的手。

“你说呢？”

“我不知道。”逗她玩？还是觉得她的手可以随便牵？

“因为证据不够明显吗？”

嗄？她一愣，只见他突然欺身上前，头一低便在她的额头印上一吻——

第2章(2)

舞冬末有那么一刹那心脏停止跳动，接下来是怦怦怦怦怦怦的声音，巨大得让她觉得这声音可以让所有人都听见。幸好，这山林的所有人，放眼望去，目前只有她和他，再无旁人。

“我们交往吧，舞冬末。”他微笑地对她说。

深深的黑眸里映着她错愕的小脸，看起来她被吓得不轻，却还是很镇定地杵在原地，一动也不动地看着他。

这一切真是来得让她猝不及防呵……

人家谈恋爱都是这么快的吗？第一次见面就被抱，第二次见面就订好约会，第三次见面就被亲额头，说要交往？

她还是继续呆呆地看着他，有点不知所措，两手绞啊绞的，要是手上有手帕，怕都要被她给撕烂了。

“要或是不要，回答我。”

“……”

“这很难吗？”

“为什么？你跟我一点都不熟。”

“我喜欢你。这个理由就够了。”

喜欢？他说他喜欢她？舞冬末的心真的要跳出喉咙了，真的。

“可是，你为什么会喜欢我？我们才见第三次面。”连这个第三次都还只是刚开始呢。

齐藤浅羽不回答，反而笑问：“所以，你不喜欢我？”

“我……”她红了脸，别开眼去，却被一只手给托起来，被迫望着那道黑不见底的深潭。

心，跳得更厉害了！整个人像是要被他那双迷人的黑眸给吸进去，再也爬不出来似的。

好像怕这样还不够让她跌坑似的，他甚至还更加靠近了她一点，近到他的呼息彷佛都吹上她的脸，扰得她心慌意乱。

“第一眼就喜欢了，相处了也觉得很好，所以觉得可以交往看看，就直接提出来了，你觉得哪里有问题？”

听起来，一点问题也没有，从头到尾都很合逻辑。尤其听到他说他第一眼就喜欢她，心都要开出花来。

“你不觉得太快了？我甚至连你家有什么人，在干什么的都不知道……”她的嗓音越来越小，到最后根本细如蚊蚋。“我只是觉得，至少要有最基本的互相了解……是吧？”

齐藤浅羽点点头。“好，我来自我介绍一下。我今年二十一岁，有一个双胞胎哥哥在念京都大学，家里还有一个前管家的女儿，因为她父母双亡，所以爸爸便把她当女儿养，我们也当她是妹妹。我妈妈不在了，爸爸是做生意的，我们都是纯华人血统，只是冠了日本姓，方便在日本做生意和定居，家住京都，来台湾当交换学生，还有什么想问的？”

“你有一个双胞胎哥哥？跟你长得一模一样？”她的注意力很显然被这个讯息给拉走了。

他点点头，轻描淡写地说：“我哥叫齐藤英树，早我几分钟出生，他跟我不同，比较严肃，看起来高高在上、目中无人……这是其他人说的，不是我说的。书念得比我好，不过那是因为他的时间都拿来念书，而我却拿来玩，他的人生很无趣很寂寞很孤单，至少在这前二十一年的人生里，都是为了我爸爸的目光而活。”

他说起哥哥的模样和神情，就像是在说自己的事一样，莫名的，她也感受到那个哥哥的寂寞与孤单。
content_en:
"How does it feel here compared to Kyoto?" She walked backwards, wearing overalls and a white thin long T-shirt, with a ponytail tied behind her back. She always smiled when she spoke and looked at him with twinkling eyes.

"Warmer."

"Wow, what an easy answer." Instead of answering which one is more beautiful, he was joking about the temperature. Is anyone so cunning?

Saito Asaha smiled."In October and November in Kyoto, it's time to see the beautiful scenery of red maples dotting the green hills. The red maples are spreading everywhere, changing colors every day."

Wu Dongmo nodded."It sounds so beautiful. Compared to here, there are only green trees and mountains...ah, I see flowers."

Not far away, the filaments spread out like powder puffs, mixed with pink, white and red. Each ball was fluffy. The beauty like fireworks looked very delicate in the desolation.

She ran over excitedly, picked up her phone and took pictures of them.

"What kind of flower is this?" The person was approaching, right behind her.

"It has a very beautiful name, called Perfume Albizia -" Wu Dongmo said and turned around, but she didn't expect him to be so close, and she bumped into his arms, and almost fell down if she lost her footing -

He quickly supported her."Why do you always act so recklessly? Did you hit anything?"

She rubbed her nose and shook her head.

Seeing this, he reached out and grabbed her hand."When you rub it like this, your nose will become flatter and flatter. You should treat it gently like this." As he said that, he gently covered the tip of her small nose with his warm palm.

His hands were big, and this cover even covered her lips.

She smelled the fragrant soap smell in his palms, and felt the warmth that spread from his palms to her cheeks. Her exposed eyes were blinking at him, and he was staring at her, too, for an instant. This made her feel that her body had become hot, and it was even difficult to breathe.

"It doesn't hurt anymore." She quickly removed his hand, turned her back and took a few deep breaths before adding, "That perfume albizia, I thought it was an unnamed wild flower before, but I didn't expect to find out when I went back to check that it has such a beautiful name. Isn't it so beautiful?"

His approach made her nervous, and she tended to talk too much.

Saito Qianyu raised his lips and smiled, and moved closer to her, so close that even her back without eyes could tell how close he was to her.

"It's beautiful, but the name -"

She took a step forward and then turned back, closing the distance between the two of them."Because it opens during the day and closes at night. At night, its leaves will hug each other closely, just like a couple..."

Midway through his words, Wu Dongmo suddenly paused, his whole face burning until it was about to burst into flames.

God, why did she tell him the name of this flower?

"Hold together like a couple does when they are having fun, hence the name Hehuan?" He took it for her kindly and smartly, and looked very teachable."So that's why you think this name is beautiful."

"No!" She glared at him in shame and annoyance."You are full of impure thoughts and evil thoughts. You are here to cause trouble!"

The way she blushed with shyness was so cute.

Saito Qianyu looked at her with a smile. He did not argue, but just stared at her tenderly, and kept looking at her. When he saw her puffing up her cheeks, she turned around and strode forward, leaving him directly where she was.

He walked slowly and followed her, not far but not too close.

Wu Dongmo knew that he was always behind her, and she also knew that it was her who was losing her temper from beginning to end.He was too calm, she was too impetuous; he was too smart, but she was too stupid... They were obviously out to play, but she made the scene look like a little girlfriend having a tantrum... This is really funny.

Thinking about it, she took a deep breath, turned around and walked back until she was three steps away from him before stopping."I'm sorry, I shouldn't have scolded you."

Really, having the courage to admit mistakes is a good virtue of hers, and he likes this virtue of hers, no matter how cute he looks at it.

He smiled softly and said, "Okay, I accept."

Wu Dongmo looked at him and smiled, feeling embarrassed again. She looked at the sky and the earth but didn't dare to look at him."To make amends, you can eat more sushi made by me later."

"Can you find another way to apologize? That sushi was meant for me to eat."

"Then...how do you want me to apologize?"

"That's it." He stepped forward and took her hand.

His beautiful and slender big hands gently held her white and soft little hands.

My heart felt like it was being brushed by the softest feather in the world. It felt very comfortable, but not real at all.

"Senior...what does this mean?" Wu Dongmo blushed and looked at the hands held by the two of them.

"What do you think?"

"I don't know." Are you kidding her?Or do you think you can hold her hand casually?

"Is it because the evidence is not clear enough?"

Huh?She was stunned when she saw him suddenly leaning forward, lowering his head and pressing a kiss on her forehead——

Chapter 2(2)

Wu Dongmo's heart stopped beating for a moment, followed by a pounding sound, so loud that she thought the sound could be heard by everyone.Fortunately, everyone in this forest looked around and saw that it was only her and him, no one else.

"Let's date, Wu Dongmo." He said to her with a smile.

The deep black eyes reflected her astonished little face. It looked like she was very frightened, but she still stayed in place calmly and looked at him motionless.

All of this really caught her off guard...

Do people all fall in love so quickly?The first time we met, we were hugged, the second time we met, we made a date, and the third time we met, we were kissed on the forehead and told that we wanted to date?

She continued to stare at him blankly, a little at a loss. She was wringing her hands. If she had a handkerchief, she would probably tear it to pieces.

"Yes or no, answer me."

"..."

"Is this difficult?"

"Why? You don't know me well at all."

"I like you. This reason is enough."

Like?He said he liked her?Wu Dongmo's heart really wanted to jump out of her throat, really.

"But why do you like me? We have only met for the third time." Even this third time is just the beginning.

Saito Asaba did not answer, but asked with a smile: "So, you don't like me?"

"I..." She blushed and looked away, but was lifted up by a hand and forced to look at the bottomless black pool.

My heart is beating even harder!The whole person seemed to be sucked in by his charming black eyes and could never get out again.

As if this was not enough to make her fall into a trap, he even got closer to her, so close that his breath seemed to blow on her face, disturbing her.

"I liked him at first sight, and I felt good getting along with him, so I thought we could date each other, so I brought it up directly. What do you think is the problem?"

It sounds like there's no problem at all, it's very logical from beginning to end.Especially when she heard him say that he liked her at first sight, her heart almost burst into bloom.

"Don't you think it's too fast? I don't even know who is in your family or what they are doing..." Her voice became smaller and smaller, and in the end it was as thin as a gnat."I just think we need to have at least a basic understanding of each other...right?"

Saito Asaha nodded."Okay, let me introduce myself. I am twenty-one years old. I have a twin brother who is studying at Kyoto University. I also have a daughter of a former housekeeper at home. Because her parents died, my father raised her as a daughter and we treat her as a sister. My mother is gone and my father is in business. We are all of pure Chinese descent. We just have Japanese surnames to make it easier to do business and settle in Japan. We live in Kyoto and came to Taiwan as an exchange student. Do you have anything else to ask?"

"You have a twin brother? He looks exactly like you?" Her attention was obviously drawn away by this message.

He nodded and said lightly: "My brother's name is Saito Hideki. He was born a few minutes before me. He is different from me. He is more serious, looks aloof and arrogant... This is what other people say, not me. He studies better than me, but that is because he spends his time studying, but I use it to play. His life is very boring, lonely and lonely. At least in the first twenty-one years of his life, he lived for my father's eyes."

He talked about his brother's appearance and expression as if he was talking about his own affairs. Inexplicably, she also felt the loneliness and loneliness of that brother.
